P&G's net margin in fiscal Q2 2025 (quarter ended December 31, 2024) was about 21.7%. I worked from figures recalled from memory rather than checked against the filing, so treat this as an estimate.

- Net sales were about $21.9 billion.
- Net earnings were about $4.75 billion.
- Net margin is therefore about 4.75 / 21.9 ≈ 21.7%.

Using net earnings attributable to P&G instead, which is slightly lower, would give a margin about 0.1 points lower.
